notes.title: Dungeon Modding is here
notes.notes:
[p][b]✨ Stickforge Patch Notes - build 1.0.0-ea-20250914 ✨[/b][/p]

[b]Balance Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Zombie Bite[/b] damage reduced: 700 → 250
[*] [b]Zombie HP[/b] reduced: 2000 → 1500
[/list]

[b]NPC Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] NPCs now chase targets when attacked from long range (ignores max aggro range once engaged).
[*] [b]Fixed a bug[/b] where NPCs continued attacking after death.
[*] NPCs return to spawn if they wander too far or lose their target:
[list]
[*] While returning, they’re [b]invulnerable[/b] and [b]fully heal[/b] at spawn.
[/list]
[*] Added a [b]threat/aggro system[/b] → NPC targeting now depends on player damage.
[*] [b]New AI modding fields (per NPC):[/b]
[list]
[*] ai.aggroLockDuration: aggro lock duration override (ms, default 5000)
[*] ai.switchThreshold: threat multiplier needed to switch targets (default 1.2)
[/list]
[/list]
[b]New Game Mode: Dungeon[/b]
[list]
[*] Added [b]Dungeon Mode[/b], with a sample dungeon included.
[*] [b]VIP/Boss mechanic[/b] → the game ends when a designated NPC is defeated.
[*] [b]Fog of War[/b] → unexplored areas are hidden until revealed.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/8c95a7b7869a1f9f0bcc51ca59dc981170eb00e6.png[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a server crash that could occur when a match ended.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon[/b]
[list]
[*] A [b]light web version[/b] of Stickforge is in development!
[*] Play directly in your browser on [b]official servers only[/b] (no mods).
[*] Designed to help [b]new players jump in quickly[/b] and grow the community.
[/list]

notes.title: Smarter NPCs, Key Fixes & Early Access News
notes.notes: [p]Hey folks![/p][p]First off, thank you so much for the incredible support and feedback on the [b]Stickforge demo[/b]. [/p][p]it’s been amazing seeing so many of you dive in, share feedback, and enjoy the game. 💙[/p][h2]Smarter NPCs and bug fixes[/h2][p]Today’s update brings some important fixes and a big upgrade to NPC behavior. Server reconnection is more reliable, Escape key now opens the in-game menu (finally!), the UI looks better on ultra-wide screens, and you’ll now hear a sound if you try using an ability on cooldown. [/p][p]And the “fall through the floor” bug should be resolved in most cases [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/817763fe4aea332318af310aff82a4de9321b16a.png"][/img][i]Stress-testing the NPC system[/i][/p][p]On the content side, you’ll now encounter multiple [b]Archer[/b] and [b]Warrior[/b] NPCs roaming the map. These aren’t your basic stickmen, they react to combat dynamically, reposition if they miss too often, and generally put up a much smarter fight. Expect more tactical pressure.[/p][p]It's now possible to have [b]"spawners"[/b] in a map that can spawn [b]dozens[/b] of zombies, classical stickmen, or any skin you want equipped with the weapon of your choice. Everything will be fully moddable by the community.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="HfXS8xYCckY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]Early Access has been delayed to July 11[/b][/h2][p]This short delay gives me the time I need to really polish the game and make sure it launches strong. That means better stability and the time to finish prepping the servers and writing the modding Wiki.[/p][p]The extra weeks are all about making [b]Stickforge[/b] as solid, funny, and moddable as it should be.[/p][p]👉 [b]New release date: July 11[/b][/p][p]As always, if you hit any bugs or weird behavior, feel free to drop them in the ⁠Stickforge Discord Server. Every bit helps.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again, and see you very soon![/p][p][/p][p]Ultdx[/p]

notes.title: Stickforge Demo launches! ✨
notes.notes:
[h2][b]THIS IS IT![/b][/h2]

After years of development, the demo for [b]Stickforge [/b]- the 2D sandbox multiplayer stickman game with epic modding - is finally here!
This is a childhood dream coming to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/fa34412458587f557d74007a81ab4414aa0a1eea.jpg[/img]
This demo offers a taste of Stickforge's core multiplayer experience: experiment with a variety of items, play with physics, and test your most creative combat setups, solo or with friends!

[b]Key Features in the Demo:[/b]

[list]
[*]Chaotic multiplayer battles with up to 24 players
[*]Game modes: Free-For-All and Conquer Points
[*]Physics-based stickman combat
[*]A curated set of weapons and items to try out
[*]Level cap set to 5
[*]Playable only on official Stickforge servers
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/1f09b8088696d1e162e278ff9786429c1065c4b6.jpg[/img]
This is just the beginning of an epic, community-driven journey.
The full version of Stickforge launches in [b]Early Access on June 19th[/b], featuring no level cap, full modding support, and dedicated servers.

Play the demo with your friends, and if you enjoy it, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1593370/Stickforge/]wishlist the full game[/url][/b] and [b]leave a review[/b]!

Your support means the world and helps bring Stickforge to life.
See you in-game!

notes.title: Development Update & Upcoming Playtest
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Just wanted to share a quick update! Development on StickForge is going really well and I'm currently in the polishing, modding tuning phase, and getting everything ready for the next big steps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/46170f65f3e767cb8c556663de98b2aa1b0ab729.gif[/img]

I’ll be running a playtest on [b]May 6th[/b], [b]7th[/b], and [b]8th[/b], and I’d love for you to join in. It’s a great chance to test things out, gather feedback, and smash some stickmen together!

notes.title: Welcome to Stickforge
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Introducing StickForge, a fun, multiplayer, physics-based 2D sandbox stickman game where you can create your own maps, items, skins and scripting.

You might remember BattleStick (a game I made with PhaserJS back in the day). StickForge is its improved, fully moddable successor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/5e75471324b37252183df04d6377416475e616a9.jpg[/img]

Many players have asked for the source code to create their own content, so instead, I decided to build a moddable, community-driven version of the game.
I plan to launch it on Steam in Early Access by the end of April or early May. Still in work in progress. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45512739/69854e0c79ae6726f41084a5036d70e9439e0223.jpg[/img]

If you’re interested in getting involved, experimenting with physics, and having fun with stickman figures, feel free to join our Discord!
Also, adding the game to your Steam wishlist would be greatly appreciated!
